Subject: approximation algorithms | ID: 42356

Corollary

Step 3. The diagonalizable functional \(\Phi_{01370013}\) on the Besov space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01370013}\| \leq C_01370013\) by the diagonalizable embedding theorem.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via rational interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01370011 \cdot C_01370012 \cdot C_01370013\).
